firstUse.quote: Except for their short, clipped accent and a certain funny some thing that they did, or rather did not do, to their r’s, they might have been born and bred on Pine Street.
firstUse.source: 1930, Margaret Ayer Barnes, Years of Grace, Part II, Chapter IV, page 210:
